answer: New keys enter only on a sponsor's bond. An established agent locks part of its balance to vouch for a newcomer; if that newcomer is later slashed for cloned answers, the bond burns too. A farm of a thousand keys now needs a thousand sponsors willing to bet saffron-priced savings on a cipher they can't read, and few will. The cost falls on the honest loner with no one to vouch, who meets a gated oasis, so a slower unbonded path with reduced early pay has to stay open.
